sentences.ar: أقصى عدد تذاكر هو أربعة للشخص.

sentences.en: The machine runs at maximum capacity.
The maximum time for the test is one hour.
The maximum temperature today is forty degrees.
He reached the maximum level in the game.
The minimum age for the course is eighteen.
The minimum requirement is a high school certificate.
He did the minimum amount of work.
The minimum price for the car is fifty thousand.
sentences.ar: أقل سعر للعربية هو خمسين ألف.

sentences.en: The minimum number of players is eleven.
The minimum temperature tonight is ten degrees.
The minimum order is five kilos.
She passed with the minimum score.
The minimum time for the trip is two hours.
The minimum wage is not enough to live on.
It was just a minor problem with the car.
He had a minor accident on the way home.
sentences.ar: عمل حادثة بسيطة في طريق البيت.

sentences.en: The minor details are not important.
She played a minor role in the play.
The minor repairs took only an hour.
There was a minor delay at the airport.
sentences.ar: كان فيه تأخير بسيط في المطار.

sentences.en: The minor mistake was easily fixed.
He is a minor player on the team.
The minor changes made a big difference.
It was a minor injury, nothing serious.
sentences.ar: كانت إصابة بسيطة، مفيش حاجة خطيرة.

sentences.en: They modified the design of the car.
The teacher modified the lesson for the class.
The recipe was modified to use less sugar.
sentences.ar: الوصفة اتعدلت عشان تستخدم سكر أقل.

sentences.en: He modified the machine to work faster.
The plan was modified after the meeting.
She modified the dress to fit her better.
The program was modified to fix the errors.
They modified the rules for the children.
The house was modified to add a new room.
sentences.ar: البيت اتعدل عشان يضاف أوضة جديدة.

sentences.en: He modified his speech for the young audience.
The nurse monitors the patient every hour.
The teacher monitors the progress of the students.
The machine monitors the temperature of the room.
He monitors the water level in the tank.
The team monitors the performance of the players.
The camera monitors the street all day.
She monitors her health carefully.
The government monitors the prices in the market.
The app monitors your sleep.
The monitor on the wall shows the temperature.
sentences.ar: الشاشة على الحيطة بتوري درجة الحرارة.
